29:53.text: And they ask you to hasten on the torment
: and had it not been for a term appointed, the torment would certainly have come to them. And surely, it will come upon them suddenly while they perceive not!

29:54.text: They ask you to hasten on the torment. And verily, Hell, of a surety, will encompass the disbelievers.

29:55.text: On the Day when the torment
shall cover them from above them and from underneath their feet, and it will be said: "Taste what you used to do."

29:56.text: O My slaves who believe! Certainly, spacious is My earth. Therefore worship Me."

29:57.text: Everyone shall taste death. Then unto Us you shall be returned.

29:58.text: (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism)
and do righteous good deeds, to them We shall surely give lofty dwellings in Paradise, underneath which rivers flow, to live therein forever. Excellent is the reward for the workers.

29:59.text: Those who are patient, and put their trust

29:60.text: creature carries not its own provision! Allâh provides for it and for you. And He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.

29:61.text: And if you were to ask them: "Who has created the heavens and the earth and subjected the sun and the moon?" they will surely reply: "Allâh." How then are they deviating

29:62.text: Allâh enlarges the provision for whom He wills of His slaves, and straitens it for whom
. Verily, Allâh is the All-Knower of everything.

29:63.text: And if you were to ask them: "Who sends down water
from the sky, and gives life therewith to the earth after its death?" they will surely reply: "Allâh." Say: "All the praises and thanks be to Allâh!" Nay, most of them have no sense.
